notes.title: Update 1.12.0617

notes.title: Update 1.12.0509
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the full text clue always being displayed at the start of the first puzzle in a session.

notes.title: Update 1.12.0424
notes.notes:
- Fixed not being able to click open the custom tab in free play

notes.title: Update 1.12.0423
notes.notes:
This major update introduces a new feature, the Free Play puzzle randomizer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43746354/78aa6ca19954f2a373164b64cf0e2abe9c80f25a.png

Just select your favourite stages and the range of difficulties, and the game will serve up a random puzzle within your parameters!

Improvements

 Added discord links to the Daily Challenge screen and Settings popup
 Added a newsletter sign-up link to the Settings popup
 Randomised the loading screen sprite selection


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an exploit in Daily Challenge mode where making lots of mistakes allowed retries
 Fixed a broken clue in Train Station VII
 Fixed an issue where achievements weren’t unlocking at the end of a chapter
 Adjusted scrollwheel sensitivity throughout the game
 Making sure the clean sweep achievement unlocks correctly in non-competitive mode
 Fixed the missing % symbol for chapter progress in some languages
 Fixed the broken hint/mistake counter on the score popup
 Various localisation fixes in the puzzle board and settings popup
 The "How to Play" screen now correctly resets back to the first page when re-opened
 Fixed the selection highlight in the free play menu floating around when first opening the screen
 Fixed free play leaderboards not loading correctly when first opening the screen
 Fixed the daily and monthly global leaderboards not being fully scrollable when first opened


What's ahead
This update also includes a major upgrade to Unity 6, which brings a range of improvements under the hood and helps prepare the game for future features.

In case these changes cause issues for you, I've created a backup of the previous release under the legacy branch. If you need to, you can switch back via the game properties window in steam:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43746354/5db806ecd979e8c9f974f5a0e6f8e854b40111bf.png

If you do encounter any issues please post them to the forum or discord, and I'll try to get them resolved as soon as possible.

So what's this all for? Well I’m excited to announce that Logic Town is coming to iOS and Android this year! In fact, you can now pre-register to download the Android version via Google Play, with iOS pre-registration coming very soon.

notes.title: Update 1.11.0116
notes.notes:
Due to an error on my part, the previous update did not actually distribute the new build! This update fixes that, so the change notes are the same as last time:

Fixes

 Fixed the timer not pausing correctly when the settings menu was opened in competitive.
 Removed impossible scores from the free play leaderboards (again).

Changes
Daily trophy boundaries will be adjusted starting 10th Jan:

Gold: 1st place (unchanged)
Silver: 2nd-5th -> 2nd-10th
Bronze: 6th-15th -> 6th-30th
Ribbon: 16-50th -> 31-100th

notes.title: Update v1.07.0521
notes.notes:
This update implements some feedback requested by the community.


 When playing in non-competitive mode, opening the settings menu now pauses the timer, as it did before the last update. Scores will no longer be silently submitted to the steam leaderboards when playing in this mode.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.07.0517
notes.notes:
This update replaces the previous development build that was live. It also introduces a couple of leaderboard changes:


 Free play mode timer will no longer pause while the settings menu is up, to prevent players cheating by solving the puzzle by hand outside of the game.
 A few suspicious scores have been removed from the leaderboard (Sorry, if I've removed your score incorrectly, but it's impossible to distinguish legitimate scores).
 Fixed a leaderboard bug that would prevent someone with a deleted score from being able to submit a new score.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.07.0403
notes.notes:
Bugfixes

 Fixed bug which could cause a chapter to automatically jump to 100%+ completion

notes.title: Hotfix 1.07.0315
notes.notes:
Bugfixes

 Removing a clue in the all clues view no longer puts you back on the first page.

notes.title: QoL Update 1.05.1512
notes.notes:
This updated implements a couple of changes requested by the community

Improvements

 Added a button to the pause menu to quickly restart a puzzle
 Added your time and best time to the puzzle complete popup


Bug Fixes

 Removed an unused firebase dependency, which was causing the game to get stuck on startup for some players

notes.title: QoL Update 1.02.1466
notes.notes:
This updated implements several changes requested by the community

Improvements

 Added the ability to reset all story progress from the chapter select menu (you need to have completed the game for this to appear)
 Added a confirmation popup when quitting the game
 Reworked hint graphics to make it clearer you should remove items from the board
 Added a "New High Score!" indicator to free play mode


Keyboard Shortcuts
You can now use the cursor keys to quickly navigate through clues in a puzzle.

 Left/Right, A/D - Prev/Next clue
 Down, S - Dismiss clue
 Up, W - Switch between regular and dismissed clues


Improved Steam Deck Support
There is now an official gamepad configuration that makes use of the keyboard shortcuts above. 

 D-Pad left/right, Left/Right bumper - Prev/Next clue
 D-Pad down - Dismiss clue
 D-Pad up - Switch between regular and dismissed clues


Bug Fixes

 Opening the pause menu will now correctly pause the puzzle timer
 Fixed issues with volume settings resetting after restarting the game
 Fixed white specks at the edges of several sprites
 Fixed an issue with custom lighthouse puzzles not generating for certain sets of clues
 Fixed issues with the display of latest/best scores in non-competitive free play

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.1440

 Updated the wording on certain triple-adjacent clues so that they're less ambiguous.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.1436
notes.notes: Fixing an issue which could prevent players from unlocking the next chapter if they'd previously played the demo version.

notes.title: Release Date - Nov 3rd!
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to announce that the day is nearly here, and Logic Town will be available to play on Nov 3 2023, at 10AM PT (5PM UTC)!

Since the Steam Next Fest demo, I've been hard at work getting the game ready for release:


 12 full Story Stages with completely overhauled character and puzzle art (over 150 challenging  puzzles!)
 A completely reworked unlimited free play mode with Steam Leaderboard integration.
 Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves.
 Dozens of QoL, input, display and audio improvements requested by those of you who tried out the demo.
